On October 29, 2026, Strategy Inc (the "Company") filed with the Secretary of State of the State of Delaware four amended and restated certificates of designations: • STRF Stock : Amended and Restated Certificate of Designations of the Company's 10.00% Series A Perpetual Strife Preferred Stock (the "A&R STRF Stock CoD"); • STRC Stock : Second Amended and Restated Certificate of Designations of the Company's Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Stretch Preferred Stock (the "Second A&R STRC Stock CoD"); • STRK Stock : Amended and Restated Certificate of Designations of the Company's 8.00% Series A Perpetual Strike Preferred Stock (the "A&R STRK Stock CoD"); and • STRD Stock : Amended and Restated Certificate of Designations of the Company's 10.00% Series A Perpetual Stride Preferred Stock (the "A&R STRD Stock CoD" and, together with the A&R STRF Stock CoD, the Second A&R STRC Stock CoD and the A&R STRK Stock CoD, the "A&R CoDs"). The Second A&R STRC Stock CoD will become effective at 12:01 a.m., Eastern Time, on November 1, 2026, and the Amended Certificates of Designations for the STRF Stock, STRK Stock and STRD Stock will become effective at 12:01 a.m., Eastern Time, on January 1, 2027 (each, the "Applicable Effective Time"). Until the Applicable Effective Time, each series will continue to be governed by its applicable existing certificate of designations. Each A&R CoD provides for regular dividends to have a record date on each calendar day and to be payable (if declared) on the following Business Day (as defined in the applicable A&R CoD), together with such conforming and related changes as set forth therein. The modification does not increase or decrease the total amount of regular dividends payable on the STRF Stock, the STRC Stock, the STRK Stock or the STRD Stock, change any of STRF Stock’s, STRC Stock’s, STRK Stock’s or STRD Stock’s dividend rates, increase or decrease the Company’s overall dividend payment obligations, or, other than as it pertains to the change in the frequency of dividend payments and other related changes, change the applicable rights and protections associated with each of STRF Stock, STRC Stock, STRK Stock and STRD Stock dividends. As set forth below, the A&R CoDs were approved and adopted by the Company’s stockholders at the Company’s Special Meeting of Stockholders held on October 28, 2026 (the "Special Meeting"). Additional information regarding the A&R CoDs can be found in the Company’s definitive proxy statement filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission (the "SEC") on October 5, 2026 under the heading "Proposal 1 — APPROVAL AND ADOPTION OF AN AMENDED AND RESTATED CERTIFICATE OF DESIGNATIONS FOR EACH OF THE COMPANY’S 10.00% SERIES A PERPETUAL STRIFE PREFERRED STOCK, VARIABLE RATE SERIES A PERPETUAL STRETCH PREFERRED STOCK, 8.00% SERIES A PERPETUAL STRIKE PREFERRED STOCK AND 10.00% SERIES A PERPETUAL STRIDE PREFERRED STOCK, TO PERMIT DAILY DIVIDENDS." Item 8.01 Other Events. Confirmation of STRC Stock Transition Dividends As previously disclosed in the Company's Current Report on Form 8-K filed with the SEC on October 16, 2026, the Company declared daily dividends on STRC Stock with record dates on each calendar day from November 1 through November 30, 2026 and payment date on the next Business Day following its respective record date (the "November Daily Dividends"), subject to the satisfaction of the following events (the "Contingent Dividend Condition"): • Stockholder approval of Proposal 1 at the Special Meeting at or prior to 5:00 p.m., New York City time, on October 31, 2026; and • The filing and effectiveness of the Second A&R STRC Stock CoD by 12:01 a.m., Eastern Time, on November 1, 2026. As noted above, Proposal 1 was approved by the Company's stockholders at the Special Meeting, and the Second A&R STRC Stock CoD has been filed and will become effective at 12:01 a.m., Eastern Time, on November 1, 2026. Accordingly, upon the Second A&R STRC Stock CoD’s effectiveness, the November Daily Dividends will be payable in accordance with their terms. Further, as previously disclosed in the Company’s Current Reports on Form 8-K filed with the SEC on October 1, 2026 and October 16, 2026, the Company declared a semi-monthly dividend on STRC Stock payable on November 15, 2026 to stockholders of record as of 5:00 p.m., New York City time, on October 31, 2026 (the "November 15 Dividend"), which will not be payable if the Contingent Dividend Condition is satisfied. On October 29, 2026, Strategy Inc (the "Company") issued a press release announcing the Company’s financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. A copy of this press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K. Item 5.02. Departure of Directors or Certain Officers; Election of Directors; Appointment of Certain Officers; Compensatory Arrangements of Certain Officers. Chief Financial Officer Transition; Designations of Principal Accounting Officer and Co-Principal Financial Officers On October 26, 2026, Andrew Kang, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of the Company, and the Company’s principal financial officer and principal accounting officer, informed the Company of his intention to resign from these positions effective November 5, 2026. Mr. Kang’s decision to resign is due to personal reasons and not the result of any disagreement between Mr. Kang and the Company on any matter relating to the Company’s operations, policies or practices. The Company and its Board of Directors (the "Board") plan to transition Mr. Kang’s responsibilities as Chief Financial Officer, principal financial officer and principal accounting officer as follows: • From November 6, 2026 through December 31, 2026, Phong Le, the Company’s President and Chief Executive Officer and principal executive officer, will serve as the Company’s principal financial officer and will assume Mr. Kang’s responsibilities as head of the Company’s finance organization and function for this period. • Effective January 1, 2027, Reza Virasteh, the Company’s current Executive Vice President of Operations, will assume the role of Executive Vice President & Chief Financial Officer and will serve as co-principal financial officer of the Company, along with Mr. Le, who will continue as the Company’s President and Chief Executive Officer and principal executive officer. In his role as co-principal financial officer, Mr. Le will be primarily responsible for the financial management of the Company’s bitcoin strategy, including capital markets activity, capital management, and treasury and investor relations. In his role as co-principal financial officer, Mr. Virasteh will be primarily responsible for the financial management of the Company’s software operations, finances and budget. • From November 6, 2026 through December 31, 2026, Mr. Virasteh’s title will be changed to Executive Vice President, Finance and Operations, as he prepares to assume the title of Executive Vice President & Chief Financial Officer. • Effective November 6, 2026, Shelley Khanna, the Company’s current Global Controller, will serve as the Company’s Chief Accounting Officer and its principal accounting officer. • Effective November 6, 2026, Shirish Jajodia, Vice President, Corporate Treasurer, and Chaitanya Jain, Director, Investor Relations, will each report directly to Mr. Le. • Mr. Kang will remain with the Company as a non-executive employee in an advisory capacity through December 31, 2026. Pursuant to a transition and separation agreement between the Company and Mr. Kang, in consideration for serving in a non-executive advisory capacity, Mr. Kang will continue to receive his regular base pay through December 31, 2026 and will also receive, subject to his execution and non-revocation of a general release of claims in favor of the Company, a lump sum payment of $883,400 and six months of COBRA premium coverage (valued at approximately $20,000) following the conclusion of the term of his advisory service. Mr. Kang’s outstanding equity awards will continue to vest through December 31, 2026 in accordance with their terms, and any portion that is unvested upon the termination of his service will be forfeited. Mr. Le’s biographical information is set forth in the Company’s definitive proxy statement filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission (the "SEC") on April 28, 2026, which is incorporated herein by reference. There are no transactions in which Mr. Le has a direct or indirect material interest requiring disclosure under Item 404(a) of Regulation S-K, other than as previously disclosed in the Company’s definitive proxy statement filed with the SEC on April 28, 2026, and incorporated herein by reference. Mr. Le was not appointed pursuant to any arrangement or understanding between him and any other person. There are no family relationships between Mr. Le and any director or executive officer of the Company. Mr. Virasteh, age 50, has been with the Company since 2008. He has served as the Company’s Executive Vice President of Operations since January 2024. Previously, he has held several senior positions, including Senior Vice President of Operations, Vice President of Operations, and Vice President of Financial Planning & Analysis. Prior to joining Strategy, Mr. Virasteh was Director of Finance and Banking Operations at Premier Mortgage Capital, a privately held financial services company, from 2005 to 2008. Mr. Virasteh holds a B.S. in Biology from George Mason University. There are no transactions in which Mr. Virasteh has a direct or indirect material interest requiring disclosure under Item 404(a) of Regulation S-K. Mr. Virasteh was not appointed pursuant to any arrangement or understanding between him and any other person. There are no family relationships between Mr. Virasteh and any director or executive officer of the Company. In connection with his appointment as the Executive Vice President & Chief Financial Officer, Mr. Virasteh’s base salary was increased to $500,000, and his annual discretionary cash bonus target was increased to $400,000 (as may be prorated and adjusted for 2026). Mr. Virasteh will also receive, with an effective grant date of November 5, 2026, restricted stock units ("RSUs") with respect to the Company’s class A common stock with a target value of $1,000,000 (determined based on the 20-trading day trailing average closing price of the class A common stock through the grant date), and an option (the "Option") to purchase shares of the Company’s class A common stock, with an exercise price equal to the fair market value of a share of class A common stock on the grant date, a term of ten years and a Black-Scholes-based target value of $1,000,000. The Option and RSUs will each be granted under the Strategy Inc 2023 Equity Incentive Plan, as amended, will each vest in equal annual installments of 25% over a four-year vesting period, and will each be subject to acceleration under certain circumstances upon a change of control event. Effective January 1, 2027, Mr. Virasteh will also be entitled to perquisites and other compensation arrangements to which the Company’s executive officers are entitled generally, as described in the Company’s definitive proxy statement filed with the SEC on April 28, 2026, which description is incorporated herein by reference. Ms. Khanna, age 48, has been with the Company since August 2025. She has served as the Company’s Vice President, SEC and Financial Reporting, since August 2025, and as Global Controller, since July 2026. Prior to joining the Company, Ms. Khanna served as Director, Financial Reporting, Technical Accounting and SOX at Intelsat, from October 2017 to August 2025, and as Senior Manager at Ernst & Young, from October 2002 to September 2017. Ms. Khanna is a graduate of Delhi University. There are no transactions in which Ms. Khanna has a direct or indirect material interest requiring disclosure under Item 404(a) of Regulation S-K. docs.text: EX-99.1 2 mstr-20261029x8kxex9912.htm EX-99.1 Document Exhibit 99.1 Contact: Strategy CJ (Chaitanya Jain) Head of Investor Relations ir@strategy.com Strategy Announces Third Quarter Financial Results; Operating Income of $21 Billion and Diluted EPS of $44.75 Digital Capital Highlights (as of October 25, 2026) ▪ 848,517 bitcoin holdings, 26% growth year to date 2026 ▪ $20.91 billion gain on digital assets in the third quarter of 2026 ▪ $14.33 billion of bitcoin purchased year to date 2026 Digital Equity Highlights (as of October 25, 2026) ▪ $19.12 billion net income attributable to common stockholders and $44.75 diluted EPS in the third quarter of 2026 ▪ $21.23 billion of capital raised year to date, 4 th largest equity issuer in the U.S. ▪ 76% MSTR stock price increase vs. 43% BTC price increase in the third quarter of 2026 Digital Credit Highlights (as of October 25, 2026) ▪ Returned STRC to health by executing $2.04 billion (1) of repurchases and growing USD Assets to $5.07 billion, providing 3.4 years of coverage on dividend and interest obligations ▪ Upgraded STRC to daily dividends starting November 1, 2026 and STRF, STRK, and STRD to daily dividends starting January 1, 2027 ▪ $1.48 billion in cumulative dividends paid on all preferred stock to date (1) Includes shares repurchased but not yet settled as of October 25, 2026. TYSONS CORNER, Va., October 29, 2026 – Strategy Inc (Nasdaq: STRF/STRC/STRK/STRD/MSTR; LuxSE: STRE) ("Strategy" or the "Company"), the largest institutional holder of bitcoin and the world’s first Bitcoin Treasury Company, today announces financial results for the three-month period ended September 30, 2026 (the third quarter of its 2026 fiscal year). "Strategy demonstrated its commitment to returning STRC to health. We grew our USD Assets to $5.1 billion, increased USD Duration to 3.4 years, and repurchased $2.0 billion of STRC. We also continued to innovate. With shareholder approval on October 28, we upgraded STRF, STRC, STRK, and STRD to daily dividends, so investors can accrue dividends every calendar day of the year, including weekends and holidays. Daily dividends are a natural step toward the tokenized, 24/7/365 financial system. Digital Credit is being built for that world, and Strategy intends to lead it," said Phong Le, President and Chief Executive Officer. "Q3 operating income of $21 billion was the largest ever in Strategy’s history. We've also raised $21 billion of equity capital and increased our bitcoin holdings by 26% year-to-date in a challenging bitcoin market. Lastly, it has been an honor and privilege to serve as Strategy’s CFO for the past four and a half years, and I am grateful for the support of Michael, Phong, the Board, our employees and our shareholders through the tremendous growth over that period," said Andrew Kang, Chief Financial Officer. "We’re at the beginning of the next bitcoin bull market. Banks are embracing bitcoin, bitcoin’s dominance among digital assets is growing, institutional demand is back, and bitcoin price is 21% above its 200-week moving average. Digital Credit continues to grow, with $16 billion in notional value across ten publicly listed securities. Strategy continues to lead this industry with 84% market share and STRC returning to strength," said Michael Saylor, Founder and Executive Chairman. Q3 Financial Summary ▪ Operating Income: Operating income for the third quarter of 2026 was $20.91 billion, compared to $3.89 billion of operating income for the third quarter of 2025. Operating income for the third quarter of 2026 includes a gain on the Company’s digital assets of $20.91 billion, compared to a gain on the Company’s digital assets of $3.89 billion for the third quarter of 2025. ▪ Net Income and Net Income Attributable to Common Stock: For the third quarter of 2026, the Company reported a net income of $19.53 billion, or diluted earnings per common share of $44.75, as compared to a net income of $2.79 billion, or diluted earnings per common share of $8.42, for the third quarter of 2025. Net income attributable to common stockholders for the third quarter of 2026 was $19.12 billion, reflecting $419.6 million of dividends on preferred stock, compared to net income attributable to common stockholders of $2.65 billion, reflecting $139.9 million of dividends on preferred stock, for the third quarter of 2025. ▪ Cash and Cash Equivalents, and Short-term Investments: As of September 30, 2026, the Company had cash and cash equivalents of $2.50 billion, as compared to $1.71 billion as of June 30, 2026. As of September 30, 2026, the Company had short-term investments of $3.40 billion, as compared to short-term investments of $736.1 million as of June 30, 2026. ▪ Revenues: Total revenues for the third quarter of 2026 were $125.4 million, compared to total revenues of $128.7 million for the third quarter of 2025, a 3% decrease year-over-year. ▪ Gross Profit: Gross profit for the third quarter of 2026 was $89.6 million, representing a 71% gross margin, compared to $90.7 million, representing a gross margin of 70%, for the third quarter of 2025. Important Information About KPIs The Company seeks to acquire bitcoin in a manner it believes to be accretive to common stockholders. To assess achievement of this strategy, the Company monitors and reviews the following Key Performance Indicators ("KPIs"): ▪ Bitcoin Per Share (in Sats) (or BPS (in Sats) ) represents the ratio between the Company’s gross bitcoin holdings and its Assumed Diluted Shares Outstanding, expressed in terms of "Satoshis" or "Sats", where: ▪ "Assumed Diluted Shares Outstanding" refers to the aggregate of the Company’s Basic Shares Outstanding as of the dates presented plus all additional shares that would result from the assumed conversion of all outstanding convertible notes and convertible preferred stock, exercise of all outstanding stock option awards, and settlement of all outstanding restricted stock units and performance stock units as of such dates. Assumed Diluted Shares Outstanding is not calculated using the treasury method, incorporates approximate forfeitures of awards in the current period which may be subject to future adjustment and does not take into account any vesting conditions (in the case of equity awards), the exercise price of any stock option awards or any contractual conditions limiting convertibility of convertible debt instruments. ▪ "Basic Shares Outstanding" reflects the actual class A common stock and class B common stock outstanding as of the dates presented. For purposes of this calculation, outstanding shares of such stock are deemed to include shares, if any, that (A) were sold under at-the-market equity offering programs, or (B) were issued pursuant to (i) options that had been exercised, (ii) restricted stock units that have vested or (iii) conversion requests received with respect to convertible securities, but which in each case were pending issuance as of the dates presented. ▪ A "Satoshi" or a "Sat" is one one-hundred-millionth of one bitcoin, currently the smallest indivisible unit of a bitcoin. ▪ BTC Yield represents the percentage change in BPS (in Sats) over a period. It is calculated by dividing the difference in BPS between the beginning of a period and the end of a period by the BPS at the beginning of the period. For an interim Measurement Period that is part of a longer Reference Period, BTC Yield is calculated as the BTC Yield for the period from the beginning of the Reference Period to the end of the Measurement Period, less the BTC Yield for the period from the beginning of the Reference Period to the beginning of the Measurement Period. ▪ BTC Gain represents the BTC Yield for a period in gross bitcoin terms. It is calculated by multiplying the BTC Yield for that period by the Company’s gross bitcoin holdings at the beginning of a specified period. For an interim Measurement Period that is part of a longer Reference Period, BTC Gain is calculated by multiplying the BTC Yield for the Measurement Period by the Company’s gross bitcoin holdings at the beginning of the Reference Period. ▪ BTC $ Gain represents BTC Gain as an illustrative dollar value. It is calculated by multiplying the BTC Gain by the market price of bitcoin as reported on the Coinbase exchange as of the applicable measurement time. "Measurement Period" refers to the period being measured, and "Reference Period" refers to the longer period of which the Measurement Period may be a sub-part. When the Company presents these metrics for an interim period within a fiscal year (e.g., a monthly, quarterly, or quarter-to-date period), then the Measurement Period is that interim period, and unless otherwise stated, the Reference Period is the fiscal year-to-date period ending on the last day of the Measurement Period. For example, assume BPS (in Sats) is 100 at the beginning of a fiscal year, 110 at the end of the first quarter and 125 at the end of the second quarter. The BTC Yield for the second quarter is calculated as (125/100 − 1) less (110/100 − 1), or 15%. The first and second quarter BTC Yields of 10% and 15%, respectively, sum to the year-to-date BTC Yield of 25%. With 1,000 bitcoin held at the beginning of the fiscal year, BTC Gain would be 100 bitcoin (10% × 1,000) and 150 bitcoin (15% × 1,000) for the first and second quarters, respectively, which sum to the year-to-date BTC Gain of 250 bitcoin. For determining BTC $ Gain quarter to date and year to date, unless otherwise specified, the Company uses the current market price of bitcoin as reported on the Coinbase exchange as of the applicable measurement time. For determining BTC $ Gain for a past fiscal year or other past period, the Company uses the market price of bitcoin as of 4:00pm ET as reported on the Coinbase exchange on the last day of the applicable period, unless stated otherwise. These prices are used solely to facilitate these illustrative calculations. The Company uses BPS (in Sats), BTC Yield, BTC Gain and BTC $ Gain as KPIs to help assess the performance of its strategy of acquiring bitcoin in a manner it believes to be accretive to shareholders. The Company also believes these KPIs can supplement investors’ understanding of how the Company chooses to fund bitcoin purchases and the value created in a period: ▪ BPS (in Sats) provides management and investors a baseline with which to assess the Company’s achievement of its strategy of acquiring bitcoin in an accretive manner over a given period. When evaluating a capital raise transaction, the Company considers the impact the transaction will have on this metric. This metric forms the baseline for the Company’s BTC Yield, BTC Gain and BTC $ Gain KPIs, each of which presents the change in BPS (in Sats) over a period in a different format. ▪ BTC Yield helps management and investors assess the Company’s achievement of its strategy of acquiring bitcoin in an accretive manner across periods. The Company uses BTC Yield to evaluate whether its capital markets activity and bitcoin acquisition strategy have resulted in gross per-share accretion (or dilution) on an Assumed Diluted Shares Outstanding basis over an applicable period, and to compare the impact of its strategy across periods. ▪ BTC Gain helps the Company measure the accretive or dilutive impact of the change in BPS (in Sats) over an applicable period in absolute terms relative to the Company’s bitcoin holdings. This metric can be particularly helpful when comparing the execution of the Company’s capital markets strategy across periods. A larger bitcoin asset base may produce a lower BTC Yield but the same BTC Gain. For example, a 10% BTC Yield on 100,000 bitcoin and a 5% BTC Yield on 200,000 bitcoin each result in a BTC Gain of 10,000 bitcoin. ▪ BTC $ Gain further expresses the percentage change reflected in the BTC Yield metric as an illustrative dollar value by multiplying that bitcoin-denominated change by the market price of bitcoin at the end of the applicable period as described above. The Company refers to this metric for illustrative purposes to consider the magnitude of BTC Gain with reference to the market price of bitcoin. When management uses these metrics, management takes into account their various limitations. With respect to BPS (in Sats), BTC Yield, BTC Gain and BTC $ Gain, these limitations include that the metrics: ▪ do not take into account that the Company’s assets, including its bitcoin, are subject to (i) all of the Company’s existing and future liabilities, including its debt, and (ii) the preferential rights of the Company’s preferred stockholders to dividends and the Company’s assets in a liquidation, and that all such claims rank senior to those of the Company’s common equity. Therefore, holders of such excluded instruments may have claims on the Company’s assets (including bitcoin) senior to those of holders of common stock in the event of the Company’s liquidation. As a result, the additional bitcoin acquired using proceeds from the sale of such instruments may not accrete to common stockholders; and ▪ assume that all indebtedness will be refinanced or, in the case of the Company’s senior convertible debt instruments and convertible preferred stock, converted into shares of class A common stock in accordance with their respective terms. Different assumptions would produce materially different results, and these KPIs may overstate or understate the Company’s bitcoin that would remain attributable to holders of common stock after accounting for senior claims (net of the Company’s USD Assets). BPS (in Sats), BTC Yield, BTC Gain and BTC $ Gain are not, and should not be understood as, financial performance, valuation or liquidity measures. Specifically: ▪ BPS (in Sats) does not represent (i) the Company's ability to satisfy its financial obligations, or (ii) the Company’s book value per share. ▪ BTC Yield is not equivalent to "yield" in the traditional financial context. It is not a measure of the return on investment the Company’s shareholders may have achieved historically or can achieve in the future by purchasing stock of the Company. Nor is it a measure of income generated by the Company’s operations or its bitcoin holdings, return on investment on its bitcoin holdings, or any other similar financial measure of the performance of its business or assets. ▪ BTC Gain and BTC $ Gain are not equivalent to "gain" in the traditional financial context. They also are not measures of the return on investment the Company’s shareholders may have achieved historically or can achieve in the future by purchasing stock of the Company. Nor are they measures of income generated by the Company’s operations or its bitcoin holdings, return on investment on its bitcoin holdings, or any other similar financial measure of the performance of its business or assets. BTC $ Gain also does not represent a fair value gain of the Company’s bitcoin holdings nor any other realized or unrealized financial gain. BTC $ Gain may be positive during periods when the Company has incurred fair value losses on its bitcoin holdings, or negative during periods when the Company has incurred fair value gains on its bitcoin holdings. The trading price of the Company’s class A common stock is informed by numerous factors in addition to the Company’s bitcoin holdings and its actual or potential shares of common stock outstanding. As a result, the trading price of the Company’s securities can deviate significantly from the fair market value of the Company’s bitcoin. None of BPS (in Sats), BTC Yield, BTC Gain or BTC $ Gain is indicative or predictive of the trading price of the Company’s securities. Investors should rely on the financial statements and other disclosures contained in the Company’s SEC filings. In particular, the Company has adopted Accounting Standards Update No. 2023-08, Intangibles—Goodwill and Other—Crypto Assets (Subtopic 350-60): Accounting for and Disclosure of Crypto Assets ("ASU 2023-08"). ASU 2023-08 requires the Company to measure its bitcoin at fair value in its statement of financial position as of the end of a reported period, and to recognize gains and losses from changes in the fair value in net income (loss) for the reported period. As a result, the Company may incur unrealized gain or loss on digital assets based on changes in the market price of bitcoin during a period, as well as gain or loss from the sale of digital assets during a period. These gains and losses are not reflected in BPS (in Sats), BTC Yield, BTC Gain or BTC $ Gain. For example, if the Company increases its bitcoin holdings relative to Assumed Diluted Shares Outstanding during a reported period, the Company would achieve increased BPS (in Sats) and positive BTC Yield, BTC Gain and BTC $ Gain even if the Company reports significant realized or unrealized loss on digital assets for the period. Similarly, if the Company increases Assumed Diluted Shares Outstanding at a faster rate than its bitcoin holdings, then the Company would experience decreased BPS (in Sats) and negative BTC Yield, BTC Gain, and BTC $ Gain, even if the Company reports significant unrealized gain on digital assets for the period. As noted above, these KPIs are narrow in purpose and are used by management to help assess whether the Company is raising and deploying capital in a manner accretive to shareholders solely as it pertains to its bitcoin holdings. References to a transaction, or to the Company’s capital deployment, being "accretive" or "dilutive" refer only to the effect on the specified KPI under the stated assumptions. They do not mean that the transaction is accretive or dilutive to the Company’s earnings, cash flow, book value, enterprise value, intrinsic value, or the trading price of the Company’s securities. In calculating BPS (in Sats), BTC Yield, BTC Gain, and BTC $ Gain, the Company does not consider the source of capital used to acquire its bitcoin. When the Company purchases bitcoin using proceeds from offerings of non-convertible notes or non-convertible preferred stock, or convertible notes or preferred stock that carry conversion prices above the current trading price of the Company's common stock or conversion rights that are not then exercisable, such transactions have the effect of increasing the BPS (in Sats), BTC Yield, BTC Gain and BTC $ Gain, while also increasing the Company’s indebtedness and senior claims of holders of instruments other than class A common stock with respect to dividends and to the Company’s assets, including its bitcoin, if the Company were to liquidate, in a manner that is not reflected in these metrics. If any of the Company’s convertible notes mature or are redeemed without being converted into common stock, or if the Company elects to redeem or repurchase its non-convertible instruments (including certain of its perpetual preferred stock), the Company may be required to sell shares of its class A common stock or bitcoin to generate sufficient cash proceeds to satisfy those obligations, either of which would have the effect of decreasing BPS (in Sats), BTC Yield, BTC Gain and BTC $ Gain. The assumptions used in calculating these metrics do not contemplate adjustments for such decreases. Accordingly, these metrics might overstate or understate the accretive nature of the Company’s use of capital to buy bitcoin because not all bitcoin is purchased using proceeds from issuances of class A common stock, instruments that are convertible into class A common stock may be forfeited or repaid with funds other than from the sale of class A common stock in the period in question rather than being exercised for or converted into class A common stock and not all proceeds from issuances of class A common stock are used to purchase bitcoin. In addition, the Company is required to pay dividends with respect to its perpetual preferred stock in perpetuity. The Company could pay these dividends with cash or, in the case of STRK Stock, by issuing shares of class A common stock. The Company has issued shares of class A common stock and certain series of its preferred stock for cash to fund the payment of cash dividends. In the future, the Company may also issue shares of class A common stock in lieu of paying dividends on STRK Stock. As a result, the Company has experienced, and may experience in the future, increases in Assumed Diluted Shares Outstanding without corresponding increases in its bitcoin holdings, resulting in decreases in BPS (in Sats), BTC Yield, BTC Gain and BTC $ Gain for the applicable periods. The Company has historically not paid any dividends on its shares of class A common stock, and by presenting these KPIs the Company makes no suggestion that it intends to do so in the future. Holders of the Company’s securities, including its class A common stock and preferred stock, have no ownership interest in, or redemption right with respect to, the Company's bitcoin holdings. The Company determines its KPI targets based on its history and future goals. The Company’s ability to maintain any given level of BPS (in Sats), or achieve positive BTC Yield, BTC Gain, or BTC $ Gain may depend on a variety of factors, including factors outside of its control, such as the price of bitcoin, and the availability of debt and equity financing on favorable terms. Past performance is not indicative of future results, and the Company’s KPI results for any particular interim period may not be indicative of its ability to achieve longer-term objectives under its bitcoin strategy. Additionally, the Company’s KPIs may improve, and the Company may achieve its targets or objectives, even as it incurs losses or the market price of its class A common stock declines. These KPIs are merely supplements, not substitutes for the financial statements and other disclosures contained in the Company’s SEC filings. An ex-dividend date is the first day on which shares trade without the right to receive a particular dividend. For shares traded on Nasdaq, the ex-dividend date is generally the same day as the record date, if it falls on a trading day, or the immediately preceding business day, if the record date does not fall on a trading day. As a result, if multiple daily dividends have record dates that fall on consecutive days that are DTC holidays, then they will be deemed by DTC to share a single record date occurring on the last preceding day that is not a DTC holiday, and by Nasdaq to share a single ex-dividend date occurring on the last preceding day that is a trading day, and will be paid together on the same payment date. Regular dividends will be payable when, as and if declared by Strive’s board of directors ("Board") or any duly authorized committee thereof, out of funds legally available for their payment, in arrears for each regular dividend period on each regular dividend payment date to stockholders of record as of the close of business on the regular record date immediately preceding the applicable regular dividend payment date. No dividend, interest or other amount will accumulate or accrue on any unpaid regular dividends, regardless of whether regular dividends are declared for any future regular dividend period. Declared regular dividends on the SATS Stock will be payable solely in cash in the manner, and subject to the provisions, described in the Certificate of Designation. Strive has the right, at its election, to redeem all, but not less than all, of the SATS Stock, at any time, for cash if the total number of shares of all SATS Stock then outstanding is less than 25% of the total number of shares of SATS Stock originally issued in the Offering and in any future offering, taken together. In addition, Strive has the right to redeem all, but not less than all, of the SATS Stock if certain tax events occur. The redemption price for any SATS Stock to be redeemed will be a cash amount equal to the Liquidation Preference of the SATS Stock to be redeemed as of the business day before the date on which Strive provides the related redemption notice, plus accumulated and unpaid regular dividends, if any, thereon to, and including, the redemption date. If an event that constitutes a "Fundamental Change" under the Certificate of Designation governing the SATS Stock occurs, then holders of the SATS Stock will have the right to require Strive to repurchase some or all of their shares of SATS Stock at a cash repurchase price equal to the stated amount of the SATS Stock to be repurchased, plus accumulated and unpaid regular dividends, if any, to, and including, the Fundamental Change repurchase date. The SATS Stock has voting rights with respect to certain amendments to Strive’s articles of incorporation or the Certificate of Designation, certain business combination transactions and certain other matters. However, holders of the SATS Stock will not always be entitled to vote with holders of Class A Common Stock on matters on which holders of Class A Common Stock are entitled to vote. ("Strive" or the "Company") (Nasdaq: ASST), announced today the closing of its upsized initial public offering of 7,000,000 shares of Strive’s 15.00% Series A Perpetual SATS Preferred Stock (the "SATS Stock"), at a public offering price of $90 per share. The SATS Stock is expected to begin trading on the Nasdaq Global Market on or around October 20, 2026, under the ticker symbol "SATS." "The successful, upsized IPO of SATS marks a critical milestone in our strategy to maximize long-term total returns for our common equity investors," said Matt Cole, Chairman and CEO of Strive. "We believe maintaining a high Amplification Ratio is the most important driver of our ability to outperform Bitcoin over time. SATS provides an additional tool to achieve that objective while simultaneously strengthening SATA’s credit profile by adding junior capital beneath it. With two complementary income securities, SATA designed for price stability and SATS designed for income stability, we believe Strive is better positioned than ever to capitalize on Bitcoin’s long-term growth." The SATS Stock accumulates cumulative dividends at a rate per annum equal to 15.00% on the stated amount of $100 per share (the "stated amount") thereof. Regular dividends on the SATS Stock will be payable when, as and if declared by Strive’s board of directors or any duly authorized committee thereof, out of funds legally available for their payment, in arrears for each regular dividend period on each payment date to stockholders of record as of the close of business on the regular record date immediately preceding the applicable regular dividend payment date. Regular dividend dates will fall on each business day, as defined in the governing documentation for the SATS Stock, beginning on November 9, 2026. If declared in full, the first scheduled regular dividend on the SATS Stock payable will include all accrued and unpaid dividends from and after the closing date. "We believe credit risk is easiest to manage when it is transparent," said Jeff Walton, Chief Risk Officer. "SATS and SATA holders can observe the Bitcoin balance sheet that protects their dividend in real time, priced continuously, not just four times a year. As artificial intelligence and trading algorithms take on more portfolio-level decisions, we think our credit instruments are built for that future, interfacing with humans equipped with advanced compute. We don’t have any debt, or maturities, and we’re focused on a single obligation, the dividend. I believe that is what the best capital structure in the world looks like." "SATS represents the next evolution of our commitment to developing products tailored to the distinct needs of investors, introducing a fixed-rate perpetual security to our offerings," said Ben Werkman, Chief Investment Officer. "By expanding our range of highly liquid securities, we are more precisely aligning each product with the objectives of the investors it serves. This approach reflects our broader vision of building a differentiated family of financial securities combining thoughtful structures, institutional-grade liquidity, and an unwavering commitment to long-term value creation." The offering was conducted pursuant to the Form S-3 registration statement, and was made only by means of a prospectus supplement and an accompanying prospectus. An electronic copy of the final prospectus supplement, together with the accompanying prospectus, is available on the SEC’s website at www.sec.gov . About Strive Strive is a structured finance company focused on disciplined capital allocation and long term value creation. We have strategically adopted bitcoin as our hurdle rate for capital deployment because of our fiduciary duty to maximize long-term value for stockholders and compound purchasing power over time. Strive Asset Management, LLC, a direct, wholly owned subsidiary of Strive and an SEC-registered investment adviser, manages over $2.8 billion in assets. docs.text: EX-99.1 2 ex99-1.htm EX-99.1 Exhibit 99.1 Bitmine Immersion Technologies (BMNR) Announces ETH Holdings Reach 6.05 Million Tokens, and Total Crypto and Total Cash & Marketable Securities Holdings of $15 Billion Bitmine repurchased 2.04 million shares in the past week Bitmine has repurchased a cumulative 22.9 million shares so far in 2026, the largest ever crypto treasury company equity buyback executed Bitmine owns 4.95% of the total ETH coin supply of 122.2 million Bitmine is 99% of the way to the ‘Alchemy of 5%’ in just 15 months Bitmine released Chairman’s Message on October 7 titled "Crypto Bull Underway — This Cycle Likely the Largest" Bitmine was added to the Russell 1000 Large-cap index on June 26, 2026 Bitmine’s Series A Preferred Stock is trading on the NYSE under the symbol BMNP Bitmine has 5,227,037 staked ETH, representing $12.3 billion at $2,356 per ETH. ("Bitmine" or the "Company"), a Bitcoin and Ethereum Network company with a focus on the accumulation of crypto for long term investment, today announced Bitmine crypto + total cash & marketable securities + "moonshots" holdings totaling $15 billion. As of October 25, 2026 at 2:00pm ET, the Company’s crypto holdings are comprised of 6,051,933 ETH at $2,356 per ETH (per Coinbase NASDAQ: COIN), 215 Bitcoin (BTC), $180 million stake in Beast Industries, $76 million stake in Eightco Holdings (NASDAQ: ORBS) ("moonshots") and total cash & marketable securities of $514 million. Bitmine’s ETH holdings are 4.95% of the ETH supply (of 122.2 million ETH). "Crypto got pulled down by the same ‘risk off’ forces behind the AI sell-off. In contrast to late-2025 and early 2026, crypto pullbacks have been comparatively shallow. ETH has fallen 13% from its recent peak while US semiconductors ($SOXX) is down 20% in that same timeframe. We believe this is further evidence that a crypto bull market is underway," stated Thomas "Tom" Lee, Chairman of Bitmine. "Bitmine executed equity buybacks in the past week, acquiring 2.04 million shares, repurchased at an average price of $22.48. When management believes Bitmine shares are relatively undervalued, the Company intends to accretively repurchase shares, subject to market conditions and under the existing repurchase authorization. Optimizing shareholder value remains our top objective," continued Lee. In 2026, Bitmine has repurchased 22.9 million common shares, at an average price of $17.48 or an aggregate amount of $399.6 million. "This is the largest crypto treasury company common equity buyback ever executed, and reflects our commitment to shareholders," stated Lee. "We believe Bitmine is positioned to outperform the crypto bull market that we expect to be coming, as the Company has strengthened its competitive position over the past year in the midst of a crypto winter (bear market)," stated Lee. "Over the past week, we acquired 10,452 ETH. Bitmine’s track record of consistent buying of crypto is unmatched by any public company in the world. Bitmine has bought ETH each and every week since the inception of the ETH Treasury Strategy on June 30, 2025," stated Lee. On October 7, Bitmine released its latest Chairman’s message titled "Crypto Bull Underway — This Cycle Likely the Largest." The presentation is available at the Bitmine website ( presentation link ). Earlier in 2026, Bitmine launched MAVAN (the Made in America VAlidator Network), the institutional-grade staking platform. While MAVAN was originally developed to support Bitmine’s own Ethereum treasury, MAVAN has expanded to serve institutional investors, custodians, and ecosystem partners seeking best-in-class staking infrastructure. A portion of Bitmine’s ETH is already staked on the MAVAN platform. As of October 25, 2026, Bitmine total staked ETH stands at 5,227,037 ($12.3 billion at $2,356 per ETH). "Bitmine has staked more ETH than other entities in the world. At scale (assuming Bitmine’s ETH is fully staked by MAVAN and its staking partners), the projected ETH staking reward would be $368 million on an annualized basis (using 2.58% 7-day BMNR yield). This compares to annualized staking revenues at $318 million based upon 5.2 million staked ETH (86% of the 6.05 million ETH held by Bitmine)," continued Lee. Bitmine’s crypto holdings reign as the #1 Ethereum treasury and #2 global treasury, behind Strategy Inc. (NASDAQ: MSTR), which reportedly owns 848,517 BTC valued at approximately $74 billion. Bitmine remains the largest ETH treasury in the world. Bitmine management believes the GENIUS Act and the Securities and Exchange Commission’s (SEC) Project Crypto are as transformational to financial services in 2026 as the U.S. action on August 15, 1971, which ended the Bretton Woods system and took the U.S. dollar off the gold standard 55 years ago. This 1971 event was the catalyst for the modernization of Wall Street, creating the iconic Wall Street titans and financial and payment rails of today. The Chairman’s message can be found here: https://www.Bitminetech.io/chairmans-message The Fiscal Full Year 2025 Earnings presentation and corporate presentation can be found here: https://Bitminetech.io/investor-relations/ To stay informed, please sign up at: https://Bitminetech.io/contact-us/ About Bitmine Bitmine Immersion Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: BMNR), together with its subsidiaries ("Bitmine" or the "Company"), is a blockchain technology infrastructure company operating across institutional digital asset staking and validation services, bitcoin mining, and strategic digital asset management. As the world’s leading Ethereum Treasury company, it implements an innovative digital asset strategy for institutional investors and public market participants. The Company provides institutional-grade staking and validation infrastructure—through which it earns staking rewards and validation income—alongside bitcoin mining activities. Bitmine holds digital assets strategically, generating yield on those holdings to support liquidity and capital formation. Since 2025, the Company has expanded its blockchain infrastructure capabilities, including developing and deploying MAVAN, its institutional staking and validation platform. The Company’s activities further include investments in early-stage blockchain opportunities ("moonshot" investments) and ancillary mining, hosting, and consulting services. Adds 5,346 SOL as Solana’s Alpenglow Upgrade Goes Live SOL treasury reaches 2,595,612 as Solana enters a new era of near-instant transaction finality CHAD annual dividend rate to increase to 14%, effective November 2, 2026 BOCA RATON, FL — October 26, 2026 — DeFi Development Corp. (Nasdaq: DFDV) (the "Company" or "DeFi Dev Corp."), the first U.S. public company with a treasury strategy built to accumulate and compound Solana ("SOL"), today announced that its total holdings of SOL and SOL equivalents increased by 5,346 SOL since its last update, bringing its treasury to approximately 2,595,612 SOL, up from 2,590,266 SOL. The update comes as Solana’s Alpenglow consensus upgrade went live on mainnet on October 21, marking a major milestone in the network’s evolution. A Seminal Moment for Solana and Crypto Alpenglow targets transaction finality of approximately 150 milliseconds, compared with roughly 12.8 seconds under Solana’s previous consensus protocol, a reduction of approximately 99% in the time required for transactions to become final. The Company believes this advancement strengthens Solana’s potential to serve as infrastructure for global financial markets. Near-instant finality can improve the experience of moving money, trading tokenized assets, and interacting with financial applications onchain. "Alpenglow is a seminal moment for Solana and for crypto more broadly," said Joseph Onorati, Chief Executive Officer of DeFi Development Corp. "When transactions become final in a fraction of a second, the possibilities for payments and financial markets expand significantly. We believe Solana is building the foundation for the next generation of finance, and we continue to accumulate and compound SOL to give our shareholders exposure to that opportunity." CHAD Annual Dividend Rate Increasing to 14%, Effective November 2, 2026 As previously announced, the annual dividend rate on the Company’s Variable Rate Series C Perpetual Preferred Stock ("CHAD") will increase from 13.00% to 14.00%, effective November 2, 2026. The new rate represents annual dividends of $1.40 per share, based on CHAD’s $10.00 stated amount. The current 13.00% annual rate remains in effect until the increase takes effect. Dividends are cumulative and payable each business day when declared. Through its SOL treasury strategy and CHAD, the Company offers investors distinct ways to participate in its balance sheet: common equity exposure to its strategy of accumulating and compounding SOL, and preferred equity focused on dividend income. Learn more about CHAD at www.defidevcorp.com/chad . For more information, visit defidevcorp.com . To stay up to date with the latest developments and insights, subscribe to our blog . About DeFi Development Corp. DeFi Development Corp. (Nasdaq: DFDV) has adopted a treasury policy under which the principal holding in its treasury reserve is allocated to SOL. Through this strategy, the Company provides investors with direct economic exposure to SOL, while also actively participating in the growth of the Solana ecosystem. In addition to holding and staking SOL, DeFi Development Corp. operates its own validator infrastructure, generating staking rewards and fees from delegated stake. The Company is also engaged across decentralized finance (DeFi) opportunities and continues to explore innovative ways to support and benefit from Solana’s expanding application layer. The Company is also an AI-powered online platform that connects the commercial real estate industry by providing value-add services and software subscriptions to multifamily and commercial property professionals, as the Company connects the increasingly complex ecosystem that stakeholders have to manage. The Company’s data and software offerings are generally offered on a subscription basis as software as a service. docs.text: EX-99.1 2 dfdv-exx991_101926.htm EX-99.1 Document Exhibit 99.1 October 19, 2026 DFDV Continues Accumulating SOL Ahead of Solana’s Alpenglow Upgrade Solana’s October 21 upgrade targets near-instant transaction finality as tokenization accelerates CHAD annual dividend rate to increase to 14%, effective November 2, 2026 BOCA RATON, FL — October 19, 2026 — DeFi Development Corp. (Nasdaq: DFDV) (the "Company" or "DeFi Dev Corp."), the first U.S. public company with a treasury strategy built to accumulate and compound Solana ("SOL"), today announced that its treasury balance increased by 3,983 SOL and SOL equivalents over the past week, bringing total holdings to approximately 2,590,266 SOL and SOL equivalents. The update comes ahead of Alpenglow, a major upgrade to Solana’s consensus protocol scheduled to go live on October 21, 2026. The upgrade targets transaction finality of approximately 150 milliseconds, down from roughly 12.8 seconds, representing a significant advance in how quickly transactions become irreversible on the network. A Faster Foundation for Onchain Finance Alpenglow is one of the most significant upgrades to Solana’s core infrastructure since launch, with a compelling potential outcome for users: Solana transactions that feel as fast as paying with Visa. By targeting approximately 150-millisecond finality, the upgrade aims to combine the responsiveness users expect from card payments with near-instant settlement on a decentralized network operating 24/7. The upgrade arrives as tokenized equities and other real-world assets continue expanding on Solana. For payments, trading and tokenized assets, faster finality reduces the time users and applications must wait for certainty that a transaction is complete. The Company believes this improvement will strengthen Solana’s role as infrastructure for financial markets moving onchain. For DeFi Dev Corp., these developments reinforce the rationale behind its SOL treasury strategy: accumulating and compounding the native asset of a network being built to support increasingly sophisticated financial activity. CHAD Annual Dividend Rate Increasing to 14%, Effective November 2, 2026 The Company recently announced an increase in the annual dividend rate on its Variable Rate Series C Perpetual Preferred Stock ("CHAD") from 13.00% to 14.00%, effective November 2, 2026. The 13.00% annual rate remains in effect until that date. "We believe Solana is entering a significant new growth cycle, with Alpenglow advancing the network’s capabilities and tokenization expanding its role in global finance," said Joseph Onorati, Chief Executive Officer of DeFi Dev Corp. "Raising CHAD’s annual dividend rate to 14% strengthens our income offering ahead of what we believe could be a major bull market for SOL. Our goal is to make CHAD more compelling for income investors while expanding our capacity to accumulate SOL for common shareholders." The new rate represents annualized dividends of $1.40 per share, based on CHAD’s $10.00 stated amount—an approximately 7.7% increase in annual dividend income per share. Dividends are cumulative and payable each business day when, as and if declared by the Company’s Board of Directors. Learn more about CHAD at www.defidevcorp.com/chad . For more information, visit defidevcorp.com . To stay up to date with the latest developments and insights, subscribe to our blog . About DeFi Development Corp. DeFi Development Corp. (Nasdaq: DFDV) has adopted a treasury policy under which the principal holding in its treasury reserve is allocated to SOL. Through this strategy, the Company provides investors with direct economic exposure to SOL, while also actively participating in the growth of the Solana ecosystem. In addition to holding and staking SOL, DeFi Development Corp. operates its own validator infrastructure, generating staking rewards and fees from delegated stake. The Company is also engaged across decentralized finance (DeFi) opportunities and continues to explore innovative ways to support and benefit from Solana’s expanding application layer. The Company is also an AI-powered online platform that connects the commercial real estate industry by providing value-add services and software subscriptions to multifamily and commercial property professionals, as the Company connects the increasingly complex ecosystem that stakeholders have to manage. The Company’s data and software offerings are generally offered on a subscription basis as software as a service.
